title: Panel upgrades in Palouse, WA | Crescent Electric
metaDescription: Panel changeouts and 200-amp upgrades for Palouse houses and farm shops, with the Whitman County permit handled and the price put in writing.
body:
Panel upgrades in Palouse, Washington
Old fuse boxes and crowded breaker panels are common in Palouse houses built before 1980. Some still have Federal Pacific panels that fail inspection and should be swapped out.
We replace the panel, move the meter base when Avista Utilities asks for it, and bring the grounding up to current code.
A typical 200-amp changeout here takes one working day. The Whitman County electrical permit for a panel changeout runs $95–$140, and we list it as a line item on the quote.
Clearwater Power feeds some farms east of town, and reconnect scheduling works differently there, so we plan that before demo day.

faq.q: Do you pull the Whitman County permit?
faq.a: Yes. We pull the permit, add the fee to the quote, and meet the inspector on-site when the work is done.

faq.q: How long does a 200-amp upgrade take?
faq.a: Most take one working day. If the meter base moves or the service mast needs work, plan on two.
